keyword: who has won back to back masters
claims: Only three golfers in history have won back-to-back Masters tournaments.
Jack Nicklaus won back-to-back Masters tournaments in 1965–1966.
Nick Faldo won back-to-back Masters tournaments in 1989–1990.
Tiger Woods won back-to-back Masters tournaments in 2001–2002.
No golfer has won three consecutive Masters tournaments.
Jack Nicklaus was the first to win back-to-back Masters tournaments.
Jack Nicklaus won the 1965 Masters by nine strokes.
Jack Nicklaus won the 1966 Masters in an 18-hole playoff.
Nick Faldo won the 1989 Masters in a playoff defeating Scott Hoch.
Nick Faldo won the 1990 Masters in a playoff defeating Raymond Floyd.
Tiger Woods is the most recent player to win back-to-back Masters tournaments.
Tiger Woods secured his second and third green jackets in 2001–2002.
Only Jack Nicklaus, Nick Faldo, and Tiger Woods have won consecutive Masters tournaments.
